args.content: **2025-09-01 — Reverse proxy.** Symptom: one upstream service returned 502 under load. Cause: a connection pool ran out under a traffic spike. Fix: raised the pool size and added a queue depth alert. Time to fix: 45 minutes. Alert added to the weekly review.

**2025-09-14 — Backups.** Symptom: a restore test failed halfway through. Cause: a snapshot was truncated by a disk running out of space. Fix: added a free-space check before each snapshot and alerted a week early. Time to fix: 80 minutes. Restore test planned for next month.
